column1: # mapper.csv - gives each board's output file a name.
# One name per line. Lines map to boards BY POSITION
# (board_number inside the calibration file is NOT used for the mapping.)
#   - Lines starting with '#' are comments and are skipped (they don't count as a board).
#   - Only the text before the first comma is used
#   - An empty line keeps that board's default numeric name (e.g. 3.toml).
#   - Boards without a line (or with no mapper.csv at all) get numeric names: 1.toml
#   - Extra lines beyond the number of boards are ignored.
